sanskrit:
शुक्लकृष्णे गती ह्येते जगतः शाश्वते मते।
एकया यात्यनावृत्तिमन्ययावर्तते पुनः।।
caption:
Chapter 8, Verse 26

Kṛṣṇa summarizes the two paths. ‘śukla-kṛṣṇe gatī hy ete’ (These two paths, light and dark, are accepted as eternal in this world). ‘ekayā yāty anāvṛttim’ (By one, the result is cessation of birth and death). ‘anyayāvartate punaḥ’ (By the other, one returns). ‘Shukla’ (White/Light) leads to Mokṣa. ‘Kṛṣṇa’ (Black/Dark) leads to Rebirth. The Yogī must choose which bus to board. However, this calculation is for the ritualistic yogis, not the pure devotees.
